vo_open.text: This town in Nebraska has exactly one resident.

vo.text: Monowi, Nebraska. In the nineteen thirties, about a hundred and fifty people lived here.
Then they left, one by one.
In 2004, her husband Rudy died, and Elsie Eiler was alone.
vo.cap: In *2004,* her husband Rudy died. *Elsie Eiler* was alone.

vo.text: So Elsie is the mayor. The clerk. The treasurer. And the librarian.
vo.cap: So Elsie is the *mayor.* The *clerk.* The *treasurer.* The *librarian.*

vo.text: As mayor, she issued herself a liquor license, for the town's only bar.
vo.cap: As mayor, she issued *herself* a liquor license. For the town's only bar.

vo.text: She also keeps a library of about five thousand books, in memory of Rudy.
vo.cap: A library of *5,000 books.* In memory of *Rudy.*

vo.text: And every year, she files a road plan, so the town keeps its streetlights on.
vo.cap: Every year she files a road plan... so the *streetlights stay on.*
